notes.title: [Test-Build] Localization (Version 0.1.3a_007)
notes.content: [p]Localization has finally arrived! The game now supports besides English the german language. The language will automatically set to your system language (if available). You can also manually select the language using the -language parameter (e.g., -language=en). There are more languages planned in the future.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138017/0837a4c2d69e7b8bbc93b3f8c3a880c4ef1ff84e.png"][/img][/p][p]The build is now available to all testers.[/p]

notes.title: [Test-Build] Rework Progress (Version 0.1.1a_023)
notes.content:
[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Stats added (local saving only)
[*] Mouse- und touch control buttons added
[*] Stats are showing up on the debug menu now
[/list]

[h3]Design[/h3]
[list]
[*] Library lighting set to a warmer white
[*] Added a few book shelves to the library
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Camera angle and position fixed for library
[*] Lighting bugs fixed
[*] Texture UVs fixed
[*] no more reporting while mouse is over ui elements
[/list]

[h3]Known Issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] Stats will be reset after game restart
[*] There are anomalies, that are triggered more often than others.
[*] aprox. 200 texture UV errors to fix
[/list]

Please report new bugs and ask your questions on the discord server.

notes.title: [Test Version] Progress with the Full Gameplay Rework
notes.content: Anomalies are fixable again. New notice windows for successful and failed reports were added. There are only a few anomalies in Room1 and Room2 which can be triggered with the K key for testing. A new Discord server for a direct communication about the development was created and is now linked on the store page.

notes.title: State Of The Game
notes.content:
[h3]Hey all,[/h3]

I want to tell you about the status of the development that started in February and how things are going now.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]The current status:[/h3]
[list]
[*]There is a main menu with almost fully functional game settings and save system
[*]There is a level in which the anomalies and anomaly events can be developed and tested. 
[*]47 anomalies and anomaly events from 9 categories are currently available to the internal testers. 
[*]The time and anomaly system is functional. 
[/list]

The graphical behavior of the UI elements is not yet at the level I would like it to be. Almost all horror elements are still missing and there is still a lot of work to be done to make the game run as smoothly as I expect it to. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138017/f52db0596cb3e243f9dd55e59f2ef8fff57de6f1.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h3]What I'm working on at the moment:[/h3]
I'm going through every single component of the game and making improvements. This will end up being the task, that will take most of my time. I'm also working on the sound concept and switching to a different renderer to make everything look nicer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138017/cdce48aefb38da39fb3ecf4610da1571e417e35d.png[/img]

I'm also working on the Discord server to create a way to quickly stay in touch with the testers and interested users. There will be an announcement when it is finished.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]What is still missing to start a public play test?[/h3]
[list]
[*]A stable Windows & Linux Build
[*]Some furniture for the main menu background scene
[*]At least 2 "real" levels that can be tested properly
[*]The UI has to respond in a way that every function can be accessed intuitively
[*]I have to get these steam stats running without hickups
[*]lots of little things that catch my eye along the way.
[/list]

As this project is running alongside my full-time work in the DIY store, I can't currently make any precise predictions about when which milestone will be reached. 

However, I will definitely keep you up to date.

I really enjoy working on this project and I hope to have good news for you as soon as possible.

Let me know, if there is something you'd like to know.😸

Until then, have a great time!

Miautier out!
